title: Put your hope where the world cannot reach
summary: The heart filled with the Lord is not ruled by the world's pressure. Let hope rise above the reach of what can stain, threaten, or demand your center.
takeaway: Let the Lord-filled heart stand where the world cannot touch it.
lifeApplication: Before you let the next demand define you, pause over the word 'heart.' Ask what would change if the Lord, not the pressure, occupied the center.

source.shortMeaning: When the Lord fills the heart, worldly pressure loses its claim on the person.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next anxious scan, return to the One in the heart and let the circumstance lose its throne.

evidence.coreClaim: When the Lord fills the heart, worldly pressure loses its claim on the person.
evidence.turn: Let hope rise from the Lord-filled heart instead of from a manageable situation.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before you let the next demand define you, pause over the word 'heart.' Ask what would change if the Lord, not the pressure, occupied the center.
